title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage: Allowance by Provisional Credit Timing
content:
A resolved lost or stolen card claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan is due a service allowance. It follows the business days from its notice date to the posting date of its provisional credit.

| More than | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 8 business days | 8.00 |
| 5 business days (and not more than 8) | 4.00 |
| neither | nothing |

Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

*Boundary (hypothetical):* a provisional credit posted 5 business days after the notice earns nothing, at 6 it earns 4.00, at 8 it still earns 4.00, and at 9 it earns 8.00.
